title: MONSTER CFB Game Total Page 2 — Same Page Shell Repair
problem: Selected CFB Game Total Page 2 renders as a separate mini-page and can show duplicate Jump to a Sport Page navigation instead of continuing inside the current Page-1 V45 shell.
root_cause: Step 9 manually renders the legacy V33 navigation helper before Page 2, while the frozen Page-2 runtime still renders through V38, which predates the current V45 Page-1 shell. The selected-event path therefore has two navigation owners and an obsolete render base.
patch: Render selected-event Page-2 analysis through a new additive bridge that reuses the frozen Step-8 analysis injector but calls the current V45 Page-1 render as its base. Remove the manual legacy navigation call from the Step-9 selected fast path and import the same-page bridge instead.
acceptance: no duplicate Jump to a Sport Page block
selected date and Games on This Day remain visible
selected matchup analysis continues beneath the Page-1 content
Step-9 exact-event fast switching remains active
Page-2 analytics and cards remain unchanged
